[IARC.3.6.1] The recorder (`recorder.h`) is libds's stream-event dispatch:
one emit helper per event kind assigns the event its `seq`, stamps it with the
engine clock and hands it to the integrator's stream callback, or drops it
when none is registered. Every observable event passes through it before
anything downstream sees it ([RARC.5.8.1]). It writes no trace and keeps no
event after delivering it: a recording is the integrator's.
